faq.q: How many mobile home parks are there in Langley?
faq.a: No official count is stated in this file: no official Langley park registry exists, and this page's six-park list (four 55+ parks in Brookswood-Fernridge, two all-ages parks) is site copy sourced from MLS® listings — the live listing pages show additional parks with homes for sale that this page does not name, so six is not a complete count.

faq.q: What are the age and pet rules in Langley parks?
faq.a: Park by park, and they can change — this page lists its four Brookswood-Fernridge parks as 55+ and its Aldergrove and Salmon River parks as all-ages, with pet rules ranging from "not allowed" to "allowed with restrictions," all sourced by the page from recent listings. Confirm the current rules and pad fee with the park manager before writing an offer, exactly as the page itself advises.

faq.q: How much can a park raise pad rent each year?
faq.a: Up to the Residential Tenancy Branch limit for manufactured home site tenancies: 2.3% plus a proportional amount for 2026, and 2.2% plus a proportional amount for 2027, on 3 full months' notice, once every 12 months. The proportional amount is the change in local government levies plus the change in regulated park utility fees, divided by the number of sites in the park.
